notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
We’re trying to see if it’s possible for us to get the game onto some other platforms right now. Until then this is a small patch addressing some quality of life problems and improving the experience on the deck.

Quality of Life

 You should now be able to set the game into windowed (fullscreen) mode
 You can now quick restart the game with R (Triangle/Y on controller)
 Instead of seeing “Action Button” in the game’s text the icon of your bound button should now dynamically appear


Thanks for playing pilots!

notes.title: 1.0.1 - Tidying Up
notes.content:
Hello all, welcome to the first patch notes! We did some minor balancing and addressed the most drastic bugs. It’s likely some things you guys want are not addressed here, we are reading your feedback and understanding where it’s coming from. New QOL features, such as seeing highscores from within the level select screen, windowed mode or a quick restart button.

We’re taking a few weeks off from working on the game directly to let the initial steam sales settle before we commit to anything. However what we can commit to is a set of small competitions we will be hosting in the discord. Starting next week we will be hosting a string of competitions for 3 weeks straight and we’re excited to see you all completely break the game. 

Due to balancing changes the highscores have been cleaned up! The 1.0.0 archive can be found here:
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-1vR_ISw4I7HZr3X8Di4i9HW1JLtO2LaiEZjJsOanzOdJGjYhCsR8xtw6lpjPdDGNAfYDo02B6_LQudlW/pubhtml
Quality of LifeReverse now includes a visual, 0 - 100, indicator of how much of a charge you have completedModule Balancing
All changes here are effective in both the campaign and rifts.
Laser  
Damage at high spark levels has been reduced by about 10%

Dash  
Fixed a bug where it would take a couple of frames for the immunity to trigger. It should now feel more responsive for those of you that did notice.RiftsFloor 4 and 5 fights, both HR and Elites, have had their difficulty slightly increased  Squares that travel the arena’s path should now appear in smaller numbers  The HP of shielding assistants that can appear as a level modifier has been decreased by 33%  Additionally, they each subsequently spawned assistant will appear slightly later  Floor bosses now get really angry if you fight them for an incomprehensibly high amount of time (they despise any attempts of pacifism)  It is no longer possible to lose HP on shops while at 1HP. You will only be offered common, free powerups instead.Discoveries in RiftsLaser  Effectiveness of All Or Nothing has been halved  Juggler  Several bugs related to Two Hands Only have been fixed which reduce jugglers potential maximum DPS  General  Fragments of Aidoxe are now slightly more common  Pacifist should be slightly rarerBug Fixes:The levels around Star’s cluster should now be clickable on more resolutions, sorry click clique  Several typos have been fixed, we’re very soryr about that  It is no longer possible to skip the boss changing shape animation. Rifts(Shooter) 999 bullets text that incorrectly stated that the count resets when hit has been removed.  (Juggler) Fixed card interactions that made it so you can have more than 2 Primary Jugglers while playing with Two Hands Only  (Reload) It is now impossible to fire low charge bullets impossibly fast by spamming buttons on two different input devices.  (All modules) Attack Zone affecting discoveries should now behave correctly

notes.title: ONE BTN BOSSES is OUT NOW
notes.content:
Hey everyone! This is it: ONE BTN BOSSES is finally out <3 


Thank you so much for all the support you’ve shown us in the past couple of years! We hope you’ll love the full game! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41996681/677c5d709a0eca7f652afbff249c083bbdfa9b63.jpg

If we can ask for one last act of love for this game, this is it: if you like what you play, please help us out with a review: reviews are really what tricks the algorithm into keeping our game afloat, and for such a small studio like ours they're super important! 

Also, if you like competing, this is the right moment to get in our Discord server hehe 

Once again: thank you thank you thank you <3 

Have fun and talk soon!

Midnight Munchies

notes.title: Trying New Weapons and Movements - Dev Diaries Ep.5
notes.content:

Brin and I spin a wheel and try out random combinations of weapons and movements to create the most broken builds and see how far they can go in the roguelike mode!

notes.title: ONE BTN BOSSES will be out on August 6
notes.content:
Hey pilots!!! Surprise: your favorite one button boss rush will be out in less than three weeks!

notes.title: DEMO Update - 2024/06/13
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41996681/81eb6056578dd3a53bd4af26fdeb9ed31cbbe881.gif

What's up, pilots!
We are back with another round of bug-fixes. Thank you for the reports!

In the small update 1.0.3, we are addressing some UI bugs. They shouldn't have had a big impact on you or the game, but better get them out of the way as soon as we can!

Bugfixes

 Fixed a bug where changing music volume settings wouldn't persist from the main menu to the game.
 Fixed a bug where leaving the pause menu in the overworld with the mouse didn't work and left a strange game state.
 Fixed a bug where tabbing out of the game wouldn't show you your correct time in the overworld.
 Fixed a bug where the game would let you scroll through the world with the mouse.


Remember that we currently have a time competition going on where the winners will get the chance to have their name featured in the game. And competition is fierce!

This is all! Enjoy the rest of the Next Fest!

notes.title: DEMO Update 2024/06/12
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41996681/81eb6056578dd3a53bd4af26fdeb9ed31cbbe881.gif

Hello, pilots!
We know some of you are loving the game - and therefore finding bugs that even us couldn't find (thanks!)

We are putting out another update to the game to address some of these issues, so your flights are safer than ever. Remember that we currently have a time competition going on where the winners will get the chance to have their name featured in the game. And competition is fierce!

General
There's a competition going... so we added a small sticker to remind you of it!

Bugfixes

 Fixed a bug where getting hit while restarting would cause the game to play at very slow motion (thanks Coachie and orgx!)
 Fixed a bug where pressing the button multiple times in a row would cause the player sprite to scale infinitely.


This is all! Keep your times coming and keep your runs running, pilots!

notes.title: Best Time Competition - Get Your Name In ONE BTN BOSSES Full Game!!!
notes.content:
Hey gamers!! We hope you're enjoying the Demo of ONE BTN BOSSES! We have a little competition for you - the prize?

 Get your name in the full release of the game!! 

And we're not talking being mentioned in the credits, we're talking a Boss Talking About You In-Game!!! 

How do you participate?


1 - play the last level of the Demo (The Future)
2 - take a screenshot of your best time
3 - join the 1BB Discord server and post your time there
4 - best three players will get their name mentioned by one of the Bosses in the Game!

You have time until the end of Steam Next Fest (June 17th at 7pm CET).

Have fun!

notes.title: DEMO Update - 2024/06/10
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41996681/81eb6056578dd3a53bd4af26fdeb9ed31cbbe881.gif

A few minor changes that are coming in an update today:
General

 The wording on the discovery cards should now be different, more consistent throught the whole set
 Additionally there should be no grammar mistakes now :')


Perfomance:

 The "danger" animation towards the end of fights should not cause performance issues anymore


Bug Fixes

 Playing from a computer with a Chinese system language should not break the text in the game
 In rare cases your rift save file could not be correctly reset after finishing a level. If this happens again a wishlist popup will appear and after clicking continue you will be able to continue playing normally. This is not the most elegant solution but allows us to quickly provide a fix for those affected

notes.title: ONE BTN BOSSES Demo releases on June 7th!
notes.content:
Hey Pilots, we have a fresh demo of ONE BTN BOSSES! 


It's been a while since the last time you were able to get your hands on the game, and as we're getting closer and closer to the full release of the game, we thought we'd make a new demo for you to check out how it's looking right now :) 

The demo will release on June 7th, at around 11 p.m. CEST. 

It will include part of the 4-hour campaign (including a couple of the bosses) AND the first floor of the randomly generated roguelike mode!!! We're so excited for you to play it, and we can't wait to know what you think <3 

Oh and if you're craving for a community to talk about 1BB with, you can click here to join our brand new Discord server, where we post news before everywhere else, secret updates, and much more. 

Talk soon!
